name: @spike/pxe-reference
comment: Reference harness: upstream's own PXE at the deletion_era pin, installed so that M21's
`test_form_b_tx_matches_pxe_bytes` can compare this runtime's `Tx` against the one PXE
builds. NOTHING SHIPS FROM HERE. `@aztec/pxe` hard-depends on `@aztec/simulator`, which
hard-depends on `@aztec/native` and `@aztec/world-state` — the packages DD-9 forbids the
shipped graph from reaching — which is exactly why this is a separate tree and not a
`@aztec/world-state` is declared EXPLICITLY rather than left transitive: it is what makes
this tree a harness tree under `verify_npm_pack_no_optional_native`'s own rule, and a
classification that rested on a transitive edge would be a classification nobody could read.
The pin is `npm.deletion_era`, which is `orchestration/`'s, because a byte comparison
between two protocol versions would be a comparison of two different protocols.
